_comment: Desk risk limits for the Soros portfolio. All limits are UPPER bounds (the measure is bad when high). 'warn' is the amber threshold, 'limit' the red breach. Fractions of portfolio value; weights are fractions. scenario_set is the manager-level set the VaR/ES limits are evaluated against (scenario risk needs one). Reference-metric decision 2026-07-03: MODEL VOL (sigma = sqrt(x'Fx + w'dw), factor/specific split) is the desk's reference risk number; the LIMITS are written on Scenario VaR 99 / ES 97.5 (the Kupiec-backtested metrics — replaced the house 'Total VaR 99' composite as the limit). 'Top-5 risk share' is the 5 largest names' share of the marginal-Total-VaR contributions (ch-09 CTR idiom; replaced Risk HHI 2026-07-02) — full-history, scenario-set independent. Edit freely; risk_api reloads on each /limits call. calibrated_for (2026-07-30, multi-manager Phase 3): these thresholds were tuned against the Soros portfolio specifically -- applied unchanged to another manager's portfolio the numbers are arbitrary, not wrong per se. /limits discloses calibrated_for and flags when the requested manager differs; this is still ONE flat limit set, not per-manager sets (that's a later phase).
